questions.text:
Choose ONE media genre. Write an essay discussing the extent to which you agree or disagree with ONE of the following statements, in relation to an aspect of your chosen media genre.

STATEMENTS (Choose ONE):
1. Shifts in audience demographics are the primary driver of genre evolution.
2. The pursuit of commercial viability limits the creative potential of a genre.
3. A genre must absorb elements from neighbouring genres to maintain audience interest.
4. A genre succeeds when it captures the concerns and values of its target audience.
5. The conventions of a genre are in a constant state of negotiation between creators and audiences.

You should aim to write a concise essay of no more than 4-5 pages. The quality of your writing is more important than the length of your essay. Make sure you respond only to your chosen statement throughout your essay, and support your discussion with evidence from media text(s) and/or other sources, which may include your own production experience.

You must specify your chosen media genre and statement number on the planning page.
questions.markingGuide:
This is a holistic essay marked on a scale from N0 to E8.

Achievement (A3-A4): Demonstrate understanding by identifying and describing an aspect of a specific media genre using detailed supporting evidence from a range of media texts within the genre, and/or other sources. Use detail from at least TWO media texts within the genre to support the description. Address the chosen statement throughout some (A3) or most (A4) of the essay. A4 may attempt to explain how and/or why the aspect has an impact on the media genre.

Merit (M5-M6): Demonstrate in-depth understanding by giving reasoned explanations of an aspect of a specific media genre. A reasoned explanation involves a logical argument of how and/or why the aspect has an impact on the media genre, by responding to the chosen statement, using specific supporting evidence from a range of media texts within the genre, and secondary sources. Focus on the genre, using relevant evidence. Address the chosen statement throughout the essay.

The explanation could cover: how and/or why changes in the media genre have occurred; how and/or why audience expectations and/or response to the media genre exist, or have developed; how and/or why commercial considerations influence the media genre.

Excellence (E7-E8): Demonstrate critical understanding by examining the likely implications of an aspect of a specific media genre and drawing conclusions with supporting evidence from relevant secondary sources. Focus on the genre, using carefully selected evidence from secondary sources to support the discussion. E7 responds to the chosen statement with some nuance. E8 responds with nuance and shows an awareness of the complexities.

N0 = No response; no relevant evidence. N1 = Shows limited understanding; OR genre not apparent; OR specific examples from texts are lacking. N2 = Provides a limited description; OR does not address the chosen statement.
